answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 63494 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Inara Aamir as a name for Muslim girl child Question: How is Inara Aamir as a name for Muslim girl child? Answer ID: 63494 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 208/208/SD=04/1437) Inara means: a red-eyed pigeon. It is not a good name in respect to its meaning. It is better if you choose any name among the names of the holy wives and sahabiyat (May Allah be pleased with them): Fatimah, Zainab, Ayesha, Khadijah, Maimunah etc. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
